correctness.rationale: For each index j, only a_j or b_j distinguishes the vertex a_i from the clique edge a_i a_j, so every mixed generator meets every matching pair and has size at least n. At size n the set is a matching transversal. A layer represented zero or once yields an explicit collision, while with at least two selected vertices in each layer the exact (Z0,Z2) signatures distinguish every vertex and edge for n>=5. The only zero-free cross-layer clique-edge collision would require both layer-selection sizes to equal two, which is the excluded n=4 case. Direct exhaustive verification confirms the theorem for n=5..9.

value.rationale: The complete prism is a canonical Cartesian product of a clique with K_2, directly answering a natural special case of the foundational product-graph direction. The result gives the exact dimension, all minimum generators, and their closed count, with a sharp structural explanation of why the stable formula starts at n=5.
